title: Kernel routing + calibration workflow for mixed-precision FP16/FP8/INT8 dispatch
creator: Diego Alvarez
description: Define and implement a deterministic kernel selection and dispatch path that supports mixed-precision inference (FP16, FP8, INT8) plus an automated calibration workflow and accuracy validation guardrails. The goal is to give the serving runtime a compact, testable decision layer that chooses the best precision/quantization profile per-model and per-layer based on hardware capabilities, sequence-length distribution, and accuracy constraints. This ticket covers: 1) kernel selector design and registry; 2) calibration pipeline for producing per-layer quantization tables (per-channel and per-tensor); 3) accuracy validation thresholds and rollback/fallback policies; 4) perf regressions and microbenchmarks for A100/H100/GPU alternatives.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime exposes a KernelSelector that deterministically chooses a precision path (FP16/FP8/INT8) given: model profile, hardware capabilities, and request metadata.
Calibration pipeline (batch offline + on-deploy incremental) produces quant tables and stores an immutable artifact referenced by model versions.

Automatic accuracy check: for each candidate quant profile, the end-to-end eval run reports metric deltas (perplexity / rouge / embedding-cosine) within configured tolerances or the profile is rejected.
End-to-end unit/regression tests covering mixed-precision dispatch, fallback to FP16 when accuracy delta > 0.5% (or configured), and correct logging/tracing for chosen path.
Performance: median throughput improvement vs baseline FP16 >= 1.25x on GPUs for quantized profiles selected for production, without violating latency SLOs for 95th percentile.
Deployment: new kernel routing code merged and gated behind runtime-1.22 feature flag with rollout plan documented.
Benchmark artifacts (dashboards + PRs) linked and reproducible from CI/bench harness.
tasks: Design KernelSelector API and registry representation (supports hardware capabilities and per-layer hints)
Implement profile format: JSON-compatible artifact with per-layer quant strategy, calibration stats, and metadata
Build offline calibrator: histogram + KL calibrator with options: per-channel symmetric, per-tensor asymmetric, dynamic-range clipping
Add CI eval job to run golden-eval dataset and compute accuracy delta for each quant profile
Integrate kernel dispatch with runtime planner: caching decisions per model-version and sequence-length bucket
Create perf microbenchmarks across A100/H100 and small-batch vs large-batch scenarios
Implement fallback policy: automatic fallback to FP16 when accuracy regression detected in production (with annotation and metrics)
Docs: Confluence design doc, console flags to expose selected precision in traces, and Runbook for incidents
calibration_notes: We ran three calibration strategies on the 7B-family models: 1) per-tensor min-max with symmetric ranges; 2) histogram-based KL minimization (recommended for INT8); 3) per-channel scale with percentile clipping (recommended for FP8). Observations: INT8 + per-channel KL gave best compression but introduced ~0.35–0.8% perplexity increase on long-context language modeling sets for attention-heavy layers. FP8 with per-channel percentile clipping reduced delta to ~0.12–0.25% while still gaining meaningful throughput. Representative prompts should include tail-case sequences (long context, numerics, code) for calibration sample selection.
test_plan: 1) Unit tests for KernelSelector decision logic (simulate hardware caps and model profiles). 2) Integration tests in CI that bake a quant artifact, deploy to a canary runtime container, and run golden-eval suite to compute metric deltas. 3) Perf jobs: small-batch latency and large-batch throughput across A100/H100. 4) Chaos test: force fallback path and confirm state reconciliation and tracing. 5) E2E smoke test to ensure model outputs are within semantic similarity threshold (embedding cosine >= 0.995) for embedding workloads.
experiments_and_results: EXP-2026-02-18: INT8 (per-channel, KL) on 7B inf model — 1.9x throughput on A100 large batch; perplexity +0.62% on language bench; 95th latency increased for short sequences due to quant/dequant overhead.
EXP-2026-02-25: FP8 (per-channel, percentile 99.9) — 1.35x throughput; perplexity +0.18%; lower short-seq latency impact.
EXP-2026-03-03: Hybrid: quantize attention matmuls to INT8, keep layernorm/softmax in FP16: throughput 1.6x, perplexity +0.27% — promising middle ground.
EXP-2026-03-09: On-device calibration (delta updates) reduced drift over time for long-tail prompts in canary by 0.05% perplexity.
Benchmark notes: INT8 wins on throughput for large sequence lengths (>=1024) and batch sizes >=8; FP8 preferred for mixed small-batch latency-sensitive traffic.
risks_and_open_questions: Quantization-induced accuracy regressions in downstream retrieval-augmented pipelines (RAG) where small token perturbations cascade.
Runtime complexity: per-request kernel selection cache may add memory overhead; need TTL policy and LRU eviction for decisions.
Hardware parity: ensure H100 FP8/INT8 kernels are consistent with A100 behavior; fallback matrix for unknown/older GPUs is required.
Calibration dataset bias: representative sample selection must include edge-cases; need product sign-off on which corpora are 'representative'.
Operational visibility: what minimum telemetry is required to detect silent accuracy drifts in production (suggested: periodic golden-eval runs and sampled output similarity metrics).
notes: Implementation currently in feature branch 'mp-kernel-selector'. See PR #1123 for initial API and unit tests.
We plan a canary rollout to 5% of traffic on runtime-1.22 with automatic rollback if accuracy delta > 0.5% on golden-eval over 4-hour window.
Pairing required: runtime engineers (Aisha/Kevin) + research (Priya) to finalize calibration knobs and thresholds.
Follow-up ticket: ENG-9412 for console integration to surface selected precision per request in traces.
